d3613.Raw_Article: 3613 Ta. nallam charcoal; blackness, darkness. Te. nalupu black, blackness; nalla id., charcoal; nallana blackness; nallani black. Ga. (S. 3 ) nalam black, dirty (< Te.); (Oll.
